about.text: with 10+ years in mobile, 7+ years in VR, and 3+ years in backend; experienced in engineering management, leading cross-functional teams of up to 9 engineers.
Ranked #1 in performance out of a 70-member department at HTC within my second year.
Actively leveraging AI-assisted workflows to steer development and solve complex engineering challenges.

lines: I'm DW, a maker who loves building things with my own hands.
When I travel, my phone is always out, capturing the world I see.
I want to keep learning across fields and thinking from many angles.

now.text: Reading The Art of Spending Money, looking for the joy that money alone can't buy.

android.name: Android robot
android.text: From system apps on HTC phones to custom AOSP and the Android framework, Android has been with me for most of my career.

metaverse.name: Metaverse
metaverse.text: From Viveport and XRSPACE's virtual karaoke and concerts to 3DGS room scans, I've kept bringing people into 3D worlds.

freelance.name: Independent Contractor
freelance.summary: Solo contract work, from requirements and architecture to delivery: mobile apps, full-stack web, web rendering and UI test automation.

bullets: Independently delivered multiple client projects end-to-end as a solo developer, spanning mobile apps, full-stack web development, web rendering, and mobile UI test automation with Appium (SDET).
Owned the full engagement lifecycle single-handedly — requirements scoping, estimation, architecture, implementation, and handoff.

homee.name: Homee AI
homee.summary: Led a 9-person cross-functional team on the flagship product, worked with 3DGS, RoomPlan and Vision Pro, and cut cloud costs by 87%.

bullets: Led a 9-person cross-functional team spanning App, Frontend, Backend, and DevOps, owning end-to-end delivery of the company's flagship product from planning to production while integrating core platforms with AI technologies.
Built a full-stack, T-shaped engineering culture and standardized Scrum practices across the department.

Championed AI-assisted software development, integrating AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Gemini) into the team's engineering workflow with clear code review and quality standards to accelerate product iteration.
Architected core systems — event buses, job queues, and CPU/GPU resource allocation — reducing monthly cloud infrastructure costs by 87%.
Led a 4-person platform team across rendering and app development, delivering a core rendering-layer SDK adopted by external partners and internal systems.

3dgs.name: 3D Gaussian Splatting
3dgs.detail: Visualized interior spaces with 3DGS and rendered them with Three.js.

omniverse.name: Omniverse cloud streaming
omniverse.detail: Integrated Omniverse with cloud streaming for VR/AR devices, syncing workflows across Blender, 3DS Max, and Unity.

roomplan.name: Apple RoomPlan
roomplan.detail: Integrated RoomPlan into spatial computing applications.

visionpro.name: Apple Vision Pro
visionpro.detail: Developed and deployed Unity applications on Vision Pro.

xrspace.name: XRSPACE
xrspace.summary: Built the MANOVA VR system and the PartyOn virtual karaoke and concerts, from the Android framework down to the multiplayer backend.

bullets: Technical lead for core backend systems on AWS S3, MongoDB, and Redis; standardized API docs with the OpenAPI Specification and wired them into GitLab/GitHub CI/CD for automated deployment.

partyon.title: Multiplayer Live Streaming & Metaverse (PartyOn Virtual KTV & Concerts)

streaming.name: Live Streaming
streaming.detail: Integrated Wowza (HLS/WebRTC) for low-latency video at large-scale virtual events.

audio.name: Real-time Audio
audio.detail: Deployed Jamulus for multiplayer jam sessions with sub-20ms latency.

multiplayer.name: Multiplayer Backend
multiplayer.detail: Built and scaled game and account servers for real-time room sync (PUN) and secure, high-availability auth.

bullets: Led a 4-engineer team maintaining the core Account System (OAuth) and delivering cross-platform SDKs across Flutter, Java, Kotlin, and Swift.
Led a 3-engineer team developing Android and Unity SDKs; established internal protocols that streamlined Store integration and accelerated app-layer development.

vr2d.name: MANOVA Vr2dDisplay
vr2d.detail: 2D apps displayed in a 3D scene — owned end-to-end: custom AOSP builds, Android framework changes, SDK design, and Unity app integration.

vive.name: HTC Vive
vive.summary: Built the Viveport VR store and Cloud Portal, holding a steady 90 FPS in VR.

bullets: Promoted from Senior to Principal Software Engineer in Jan 2019.
Viveport Cloud Portal: launched a high-profile product within 1 month from business decision to deployment.
Hit a strict 90 FPS standard by restructuring image caching, compressing assets, and rescheduling rendering-thread priorities.

htc.name: HTC
htc.summary: Where it started: Android system apps and framework components for HTC phones.

bullets: Developed core Android system apps (Calendar, Wi-Fi Settings, Weather) and framework components; built the iOS companion app for the HTC RE camera with Firebase / Google Analytics.

smartHome.name: Smart Home & AI Surveillance
smartHome.description: A local edge-AI home surveillance system with Home Assistant and Frigate — old phones repurposed as cameras, pushing real-time motion alerts with live video to Apple HomeKit & Google Home.

toiletFinder.name: ToiletFinder
toiletFinder.description: A cross-platform Flutter app built in two weeks and published to the app store; it uses Taiwan's government open data to find the nearest public restrooms from the user's real-time location.

ovoy.name: OvOy Anime Wallpaper
ovoy.description: An interactive Android live wallpaper app built with Live2D, plus a BI data framework to optimize user onboarding.

ms.note: Thesis: P2P networking and TCP connection tunneling through NAT.

bs.note: Early graduation: completed B.S. + M.S. in 5 years (3.5 + 1.5) for outstanding academic performance.
